title: Inventory.reserve() allows reserving more than available stock
body:
Inventory.reserve(sku, qty) never checks stock, so available() goes negative.
Repro:
  inv = Inventory(); inv.restock('A', 2); inv.reserve('A', 5); inv.available('A')  # -3
Expected: raise InsufficientStock('A', requested=5, available=2) and leave reservations unchanged.
InsufficientStock already exists in shop/inventory.py but is never raised.
